items.b: RAPI'S ONE-CARAT RISES 0.5% IN AUGUST, ITS FIRST INCREASE IN FIFTEEN MONTHS
items.t: Rapaport's August release, published 2 September, has the 1-carat index up 0.5% after readings flat or negative back to May 2025. The 0.30-carat added 2% and the 0.50-carat 2.5%. Rapaport credits production cuts rather than a return of demand.

items.b: THE THREE-CARAT SLIPS 0.4% AFTER EIGHTEEN MONTHS STEADY
items.t: July was the first month since March 2025 in which none of the four headline sizes fell. That lasted one month. Across July and August compounded, the 0.30-carat is up 3.63% and the 3-carat down 0.20%, a spread of 4.55 percentage points.

items.b: FOUR METALS HIGHER AT 05:59 ET AND GOLD'S FIRST UP MARK SINCE 28 AUGUST
items.t: Gold $4,426.80, silver $65.58, platinum $1,762.00, palladium $1,348.00, all re-read at press time and written back to the tape. Gold recovers $119.30, or 40.17%, of the $297.00 it lost after 28 August, and stays $177.70 below that mark.

items.b: PALLADIUM'S BID AND ASK ARE $40.00 APART AND IT MOVED $13.00
items.t: Kitco quotes palladium $1,348.00 bid against a $1,388.00 ask, 2.9674% of the bid and a fourth consecutive session at that width. Crossing the spread costs just over three times the day's move. Palladium led the four on the day at +4.82%.

items.b: 90 HOURS FOR A LAB-GROWN CERTIFICATE: IIGJ AND IIT MADRAS SPLIT IT 30-60
items.t: The programme launched 2 September pairs GJEPC's training institute with IIT Madras's InCent-LGD centre. IIGJ teaches 30 hours of trade and regulation online; IIT Madras teaches 48 online and 12 on campus, covering HPHT, MPCVD and characterisation. No fee published.

items.b: CORRECTED TODAY: PALLADIUM'S AUGUST HOLD WAS SEVEN TAPE ENTRIES, NOT NINE
items.t: The tape's hold counter advanced twice on mornings the Editor re-read the mark, logging 25 August as both the fifth and the sixth session. The mark stood on seven entries, 21 to 27 August, two of them a weekend. Found by this paper's film desk, verified here.
